column1: # Diablo III: Eternal Collection 2.7.7.92380, SDK 8.2.0, Blizzard engine / NVN.
# Mac: hero creation and the first Act I scene; see README.md for validation.

# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap: a 5 GB block with a large alias region; the heap check sizes the heap region from the heap the game asks for
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# The game selects the zero-to-one clip-depth mode. Offline pipeline keys must
# use that same mode (observed in the support-only Mac run).

# address regions: 2026-10-29, in its first 15 s in nnMain the game's regions reach alias +3.42 GB, within the profile's 4.38 GB alias region (what it takes later in play is not measured here) (rewrite 3b8d4bca473f)
# CPU-written textures in CPU_CACHED | GPU_CACHED pools (0x24): at first use,
# a 2048x2048 texture has 2,829,690 nonzero storage bytes but its GPU image is
# all zero. The game writes after initialization without NVN texture uploads.
# Track those writes through the existing dirty-page upload path.
